result.rationale: The diff confirms the drift: the server schema (addGuests.schema.ts:5) is `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness refine, while the client-side copy in AddGuestsDialog.tsx includes `.refine((emails) => { const uniqueEmails = new Set(emails); return uniqueEmails.size === emails.length; })`. In addGuests.handler, `uniqueGuests` only filters against existing `booking.attendees` and the blacklist — it does not deduplicate within the `guests` array itself — so duplicate emails in one request reach `createMany` and insert duplicate attendee rows. Verifiable from the diff.
